title: Close upload authorization and import resource lifecycle
goal: Define upload authorization and close file-handle leaks in CSV import handlers.

humanGate: Maintainer confirmation of upload permission semantics

humanGateDecision.authorization: Maintainer instruction 2026-09-23: authorize the agent to complete the remaining A-round items directly, including confirming each task's human gate.
humanGateDecision.decision: Upload permission semantics confirmed: /system/upload stays an authenticated capability (TokenAuth + TenantContext, no Casbin), matching the seed which defines no upload permission key. Tightening it to a scoped permission (e.g. system:setting:upload) is not approved now; the route/seed drift guards must be updated in the same change if it is ever done.
